observations: The fixture now answers the simultaneous-trigger ordering question, but it submits option index 0 without selecting by effect identity.
TriggerProcessor states that the first chosen trigger resolves last; Arcane Denial schedules DrawUpTo before DrawCards, so a blind index-0 selection does not intentionally put DrawUpTo on top.
The next-upkeep case then reaches line 105 with no ChooseNumberDecision.

diagnosis.evidence: ArcaneDenialScenarioTest.kt chooses OptionChosenResponse(ordering.id, 0), while TriggerProcessor labels the ordering prompt 'first chosen resolves last'. The test fails at line 105 expecting the draw-up-to-two decision.
diagnosis.mechanics_interpretation: No new Arcane Denial engine defect is established by this original. The successor must bind the ordering choice to the one-card delayed trigger by option text so DrawUpTo remains topmost and resolves first.

successor: Change only the Arcane Denial fixture ordering selection from blind index 0 to the unique option describing the caster's one-card draw, assert uniqueness, then rerun the same semantic cases with all engine/card bytes unchanged.
